notLevied.why: 4100: no recurrent property tax: Constitution of the State of Kuwait (1962) art. 134: public levies are imposed, amended and abolished only by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Kuwait_1992.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Income Tax Decree 3/1955 as replaced by Law 2/2008 (foreign corporate bodies), Zakat Law 46/2006, National Labour Support Law 19/2000, Decree-Law 157/2024 (DMTT). convention R5-3k-G (Gulf state, no closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3k).

4200: no net wealth tax: Constitution of the State of Kuwait (1962) art. 134: public levies are imposed, amended and abolished only by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Kuwait_1992.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Income Tax Decree 3/1955 as replaced by Law 2/2008 (foreign corporate bodies), Zakat Law 46/2006, National Labour Support Law 19/2000, Decree-Law 157/2024 (DMTT). convention R5-3k-G (Gulf state, no closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3k).

4300: no inheritance, estate or gift tax: Constitution of the State of Kuwait (1962) art. 134: public levies are imposed, amended and abolished only by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_Kuwait_1992.txt); no law levies it; tax laws read: Income Tax Decree 3/1955 as replaced by Law 2/2008 (foreign corporate bodies), Zakat Law 46/2006, National Labour Support Law 19/2000, Decree-Law 157/2024 (DMTT). convention R5-3k-G (Gulf state, no closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3k).
